concept.title: Support at home visits
concept.shortdesc: Practical help and support delivered in a person's own home through home visits, home help or a personal assistant.

keywords.keyword: someone to help me at home
support worker to come to my house

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: home visit with advice and equipment
minor repairs and maintenance via home visit
personal assistant at home and in the community
home help and social support services
help with everyday household tasks: see (focused on chores such as cleaning rather than a visiting support service)
domiciliary care: see (personal care delivered by care workers)
home care services: see (regulated care at home rather than help and advice visits)
